verdict.rationale: YubiKey has a programmatic surface (the ykman CLI and the YubiEnterprise REST API), so asking whether it can issue scoped, least-privilege API credentials for an agent is a fair question. The evidence pack never documents scoped API tokens, permission scopes, or agent-specific credential issuance. Hardware-bound keys (PIV, FIDO2, SSH) are an adjacent authentication capability, not scoped API credentials, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
